task: Repair Native lowering of a nonfallthrough Try/Recover tail without inventing return facts.
observation: Fast Debug correctly returned from the selected recovery in both reduced fixtures, while Native traversed the syntactic tail and failed on absent ReturnValue authority. The checker already computes whether Try has any normal successor in its ownership flow. Retaining that result under the exact Try statement/callable/specialization identity let Native omit only the checked unreachable tail; an on_fail body additionally required normalizing its numeric arm-context suffix to the checker owner context.
impact: The reduced recover and on_fail fixtures now agree between interpreter and native at outputs 3 and 9. Reachable and nested controls plus fact drop/duplicate/perturb checks pass in the focused Phase 21 jobs in Default and EST-shadow.

resolution.summary: Exact checker Try continuation facts and Native fail-closed consumption pass the focused Default/Shadow Phase 21 gates.
